title: Pre-registered test of the chord (double-scaled) description of the first-order dressing spectrum at N' = 17
written: 2026-10-14, before any N' = 17 finite-N computation (no N' = 17 diagonalization of any kind has been run)

protocol.model: one-flavor N=2 SYK, p = 3, N' = 17 modes; old model N = 16, F = 8; added mode = last mode
protocol.realizations: seeds 9000 and 9001: rng = default_rng(seed); couplings = random_couplings(rng, Sector(17, 3, F=8).M) (same convention as results/data/uplift_2026-10-12)
protocol.first order: sigma^2 spectra of D = P E^dag H0^{-1} E P (h, on B^8) and D' (g, on B^7) for the realization's own eta; y = ((1-s)/(1+s))^2; W^(1) = <y(1-y)>, T2^(1) = <y> over all b_8 + b_7 = 6561 states; reported as the mean over the two realizations

predictions.quantity: W^(1), exact first order (own eta), mean of the two realizations
predictions.basis: chord 0.1470 x mean odd-N' ratio 0.925 (sd 0.003); interval = +-0.004 (2-realization scatter ~0.0015 plus ratio and trend uncertainty)

predictions.quantity: T2^(1), exact first order (own eta), mean
predictions.basis: ratio trend 1.028, 1.037, 1.063 extrapolated to 1.08 +- 0.02; realization scatter ~0.011

predictions.quantity: t1_h (eta-averaged mean dressing cost, h family), mean
exact first-order atoms (sigma^2 < 1e-9 max) in either family
predictions.basis: r_h, r_g > 1 and no excess atoms at N' = 15, 16

predictions.quantity: planar-law error in W (kron vs sampled), mean
chord-input error in W (chord vs wishart), mean
diagonal fraction of S in the inner energy basis
relative spread of the eigenvalues of Dbar (BPS heterogeneity), mean
predictions.basis: flat at odd N' 11-15; the chord theory predicts 0
